title: Meeting Actions
description: Convert meeting notes or transcripts into decisions, action items, priorities, and risk reminders.
inputHint: Meeting notes, transcript, or agenda with decisions and discussion.

tasks.title: Decision And Action Extraction
tasks.objective: Extract decisions, action items, owners if present, missing owners, dependencies, and deadlines.

tasks.title: Meeting Risk Review
tasks.objective: Identify ambiguous ownership, missing approvals, deadline risks, and protected external actions.

managerPrompt: Create a meeting action report. Preserve missing owners as open questions, prioritize actions, and flag approvals before publication, launch, billing, legal, or repository actions.
approvalPolicy: Human review is required before assigning actions to people not clearly named in the meeting notes.
Do not send follow-up messages or update external systems automatically.
